title: Pixel Whisperer
note: Drawn off dog-01, which sets the field, the crop and the line weight for the set. Re-declared for cool-flat-v2 on 2026-09-04: the field moved from lavender to the plaster the rooms now have (2 mention(s) rewritten); nothing else changed. Reworked on 2026-09-04 at Adam's request: same cap and clothes, a different face — the old one was the scene guest's, and a pickable avatar should not be him. Described in words; a likeness file in art/source/ would pin it tighter.
scene: Flat vector-style portrait: crisp clean edges, flat colour fills, at most two tones per surface — one light, one shadow — with no gradient between them. No airbrushing, no soft blurred shading, no photorealistic fur or fabric texture, no glossy highlights, no drop shadow, no outline heavier than a hairline. Simplified but not childish: the proportions and the anatomy stay accurate. Square 1:1. The background is one flat field of warm off-white plaster #e9e5df, edge to edge, with no gradient, no vignette, no shadow behind the subject and no texture. It is identical in every picture in this set — the twenty-four are seen side by side in a grid, and a field that drifts between them reads as a patchwork. One subject, large and centred, filling most of the frame. It is only ever seen inside a CIRCULAR MASK at small sizes, so everything that identifies the subject must sit inside the centred circle that touches the edges — nothing that matters in the corners, and no part of the head or ears clipped by that circle. Head and shoulders in clean three-quarter view facing right, no hands and no dog. The subject is a man in his early fifties, and he is a DIFFERENT PERSON from the guest in the scenes: short sandy-brown hair going grey at the temples and receding a little at the front, cropped close at the sides; a clean, fair, slightly ruddy face with light stubble and no beard; rectangular glasses with thin grey frames; a slight closed-mouth smile, warm and a little amused. He wears the same things as before — a black baseball cap worn straight, and a medium-blue zip hoodie over a white tee. DO NOT DRAW A CIRCLE, DISC, VIGNETTE OR BORDER OF ANY KIND: the plaster field #e9e5df fills the whole square to all four corners and all four edges, and the corners are the same colour as the middle. The circular mask is applied later by the app and must not appear in the picture; a picture with white or pale corners around a drawn disc is wrong.
mustBeTrue: the face is not the guest's: a man in his fifties with short greying sandy hair under the cap, light stubble and NO full beard, thin rectangular grey glasses; he wears a black baseball cap and a medium-blue zip hoodie over a white tee; and the background is one flat unshaded field of #e9e5df with no gradient or shadow, the rendering is flat two-tone with no airbrushing or glossy highlights, and the subject is centred and complete inside a circular mask that touches the frame edges
